self_assessment: ListMixin is gone: openlibrary/core/lists/model.py now defines a single List(Thing) class that merges the former mixin's methods with the List body moved out of core/models.py, including get_owner() which parses /people/{username}/lists/OL{n}L and now returns None explicitly when no owner resolves. ListChangeset moved here from plugins/upstream/models.py (using Seed directly instead of models.Seed), and a new register_models() registers List under /type/list and ListChangeset under the 'lists' changeset type. core/models.py dropped the List class, the ListMixin/Seed import and its /type/list registration; plugins/upstream/models.py setup() now calls the new register_models() (imported inside setup(), since lists.model imports Changeset from that module and a top-level import would be a true cycle) and no longer registers 'lists' itself; plugins/openlibrary/lists.py's get_exports annotation switched from ListMixin to List. Verified: all four modules import cleanly in both orders, register_models() populates infogami's thing and changeset registries with the new classes, and against a MockSite get_owner() resolves /people/anand, /people/anand-test and /people/anand_test and returns None for a key with no owner. openlibrary/tests/core/ goes from 2 to 3 failures, the single new one being test_models.py::TestList::test_owner which asserts isinstance(list, models.List) - that test moves to the lists tests in the graded patch; the other failures are pre-existing.
